verdict.rationale: Notte publishes an API reference section in its docs, including an authentication page and an agent-start endpoint page, so a reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec at standard paths all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive/try-it API explorer, runnable examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
